newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso breaks 1,000 barrier,but pares gain.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso breaks 1,000 barrier,but pares gain.

text.p: Colombia's peso closed the day 2.8 pesos stronger at 1,000.2 against the dollar, paring an earlier lunge below the 1,000 peso psychological barrier at the opening of trade.
A flood of greenbacks into the market coupled with the central bank's reticence to step in and prop up the dollar as it has previously done drove the peso to its highest closing rate since January 5.
The peso sped through the 1,000 per dollar barrier less than 45 minutes after the start of trading and went on to an intra-day high of 997.25 before pulling back.
"The dollar rallied toward the end of the session because a number of the large banks bought dollars to cover their positions," one interbank dealer said.
Another trader said there was widespread expectation that the peso will continue to strengthen, prompting many exporters to buy dollar futures.
"In general, exporters are buying short-term dollars futures for delivery in 15 or 30 days," a private bank dealer said.
Dealers reported a total day's trading volume of $82 million. The peso hit an intra-day low of 1,002.1 pesos per dollar and an intraday high of 997.25 pesos.
